text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold profitable stocks, but that satisfaction is not a sound reason to sell; I should judge each position by my overall plan, not by whether it shows a gain.","My account later fell despite those realized gains, reminding me that selling winners does not protect the whole portfolio; I should manage risk across all holdings.","Because price changes are random and frequent checking can tempt me to act, I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and trade only when a considered plan calls for it."]}
